headline: Uganda Solicits Egyptian Investment for Infrastructure and Manufacturing
summary: President Museveni invited Egyptian investors to finance infrastructure development, manufacturing, and value addition to strengthen Uganda's industrial capacity and economic competitiveness.
why: Foreign direct investment inflows into East Africa are vital for bridging infrastructure deficits and boosting regional value-added export production.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: Potential foreign capital investments could support long-term infrastructure and manufacturing growth.
